title: HelperFSUnwatchParams
description: Params of the helper fs service's unwatch op: the id of the watch to end, and nothing else. A path is deliberately not accepted — the id names exactly one installed watch, and unwatching by path would let one panel's release end another's subscription to the same directory.

id.description: The id the watch was installed with. An id this helper does not hold is answered as success: the caller asked that no watch of that id remain, which is a fact about the host rather than a failure of the request.
